Condition: Please review all scans and photos carefully before purchasing. We are not professional graders and encourage you to ask any questions prior to bidding. All sales are final.

Shipping: Cards under $20 that can be done so safely will be shipped via Ebay Standard Envelope. This service has longer delivery times (up to 3 weeks in some cases) and very limited tracking. If you have any questions about shipping options, reach out before auction close or within 24 hours of your order and we'll be happy to accommodate.
